playstyle.identity: Veigar is an infinite-scaling burst mage who becomes stronger with every ability hit. His cage and ultimate execute make him devastating in late game.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive stacks AP permanently from ability hits. Q fires two bolts. W drops a meteor after delay. E creates a cage that stuns enemies who touch the walls. R is a point-and-click nuke that scales with enemy missing health. Stack AP, cage, then one-shot.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Veigar spikes at AP thresholds and level 6. Rabadon's amplifies his passive. He's a late-game hyper-scaling mage.

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
passive.summary: Gain permanent AP from hitting abilities and takedowns.
passive.details: Veigar gains permanent ability power when hitting enemies with abilities. Champion takedowns grant bonus stacks.

abilities.name: Baleful Strike
abilities.summary: Fire two bolts that grant AP stacks on hit.
abilities.details: Veigar fires a bolt that damages the first two enemies. Killing units grants permanent AP.

abilities.name: Dark Matter
abilities.summary: Drop a meteor after a delay; cooldown reduced by stacks.
abilities.details: Veigar calls down a meteor at a location after a delay. Stacking his passive reduces the cooldown.

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.summary: Create a cage that stuns enemies who touch the walls.
abilities.details: Veigar creates a cage of energy. Enemies who touch the walls are stunned.

abilities.name: Primordial Burst
abilities.summary: Blast an enemy for massive damage, increased by their missing health.
abilities.details: Veigar blasts an enemy with primordial energy, dealing massive magic damage that increases based on their missing health.
